definitions.explanation: A secondary location of a company or business, subordinate to the main office.

examples.japanese: この{銀行|ぎんこう}は{全国|ぜんこく}に100{以上|いじょう}の{支店|してん}がある。
examples.english: This bank has over 100 branches nationwide.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}{支店|してん}に{転勤|てんきん}になった。
examples.english: I was transferred to the Osaka branch.

examples.japanese: {本店|ほんてん}と{支店|してん}では{取|と}り{扱|あつか}い{商品|しょうひん}が{異|こと}なることがある。{詳|くわ}しくは{各|かく}{支店|してん}にお{問|と}い{合|あ}わせください。
examples.english: The products handled may differ between the main store and branches. Please contact each branch for details.

notes:
{支店|してん} refers to a branch office or branch store of a company or bank.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {支店|してん}を{開|ひら}く (to open a branch)
- {支店|してん}に{勤|つと}める (to work at a branch)
- ○○{支店|してん} (XX branch - often with location name)

RELATED TERMS:
- {本店|ほんてん} (main store, head office)
- {本社|ほんしゃ} (headquarters)
- {出張所|しゅっちょうじょ} (satellite office, smaller branch)
- {営業所|えいぎょうしょ} (sales office)

ANTONYM:
- {本店|ほんてん} (main store) ↔ {支店|してん} (branch)
